[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Anchor the scanner rules and make scanner-hit blocks [/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]rules-versioned (sase-core)[/bold #D7AFFF]

      [bold #D7AFFF]project[/bold #D7AFFF]
